# Dr. Partition.my

> Gypsum partition, plaster ceiling and electrical works for offices, shops, clinics and other commercial units in Klang Valley, Malaysia. Operated by DALAMAN INTERIOR SDN. BHD., based in Petaling Jaya, with a team of about 40 workers. Minimum job RM 8,000.

## Key facts

- Services: gypsum board partition walls, suspended plaster (gypsum) ceilings, electrical wiring, lighting points, switch and socket points, DB box works.
- Area served: Klang Valley, including Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya and Shah Alam.
- Customers: business owners fitting out offices, shops, clinics, F&B and showrooms; interior design firms and main contractors (trade rate on request).
- Gypsum partition: from RM6.90 per sq ft of wall area (length x height), supply and install, metal stud frame, single layer of gypsum board on both faces, joint treatment and skimming included. Typical range RM6.90 to RM7.90 per sq ft.
- Plaster ceiling: from RM4.80 per sq ft of ceiling area, supply and install. Typical range RM4.80 to RM5.50 per sq ft. Light troughs, cove lighting, L-boxes and access panels quoted separately.
- Electrical works: quoted per point after a site visit; no fixed public rate.
- Minimum job: RM 8,000 (about 1,150 sq ft of partition, or a mix of partition, ceiling and electrical work).
- Final prices are confirmed in a written quote after a site measure.
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +60 12-407 6411.
